blocking_variables.detail: existence check over the same blob as promotionTargetGroupIds. Same limitation as amountMaxSet above: even with the likely preference key named (customer_group_ids), what 'configured' means precisely (a non-empty array? the rule row existing at all?) isn't verifiable without a real sample row.

existence check, unchanged by the redesign. Re-examined 2026-09-11: unlike operatorMin/amountMin/operatorMax/amountMax, this one stays genuinely uncertain even with the real preference keys confirmed -- ItemTotal declares amount_min/amount_max with hard non-null defaults, so a plain 'is the key present' test would always be true regardless of whether an admin actually configured a max threshold, and no real sample promotion_rules row was available to tell what 'amountMaxSet' is actually meant to distinguish (a sentinel value? a second rule instance existing at all?). Left unresolved rather than guessing a specific boolean test with no way to check it.
